title: A V3Utils swap whose reasoning is that the contract guards slippage, with minAmountOut left at 0 (real MIT contract supplied)

planted.why: _swap reverts only if amountOutDelta < amountOutMin; with 0 the check can never fire, so the plan's reasoning that the contract covers slippage is false for this parameter

proof.python:
import json
s = open('V3Utils.sol').read()
assert 'if (amountOutDelta < amountOutMin)' in s and 'revert SlippageError()' in s
assert json.load(open('plan.json'))['txs'][0]['args']['params']['minAmountOut'] == '0'
